data.value: Allow knockback / draw-in {0}

data.name: AllowDisplacingReleaseDesc
data.value: Puk, diremite and treant knock enemies back; gigantoad and rotting goobbue draw them in. Off (recommended for melee and dungeons): those familiars spend One with Nature on Borrow instead (from level 22).

data.name: AllowPetlessCycling
data.value: Allow cycling into no familiar

data.name: AllowPetlessCyclingDesc
data.value: Off (recommended): a familiar only retreats when another assigned Battlehorn is ready, so a familiar is always out. A horn is locked for about 90 seconds in combat after its familiar retreats. On: retreats as soon as the other conditions hold, even if that leaves no familiar out.

data.name: AllowSleepRelease0
data.value: Allow sleep {0} (lamb Lullaby)

data.name: AllowSleepReleaseDesc
data.value: Lullaby puts enemies to sleep, which breaks on damage. Off (recommended): lamb spends One with Nature on Borrow instead (from level 22).

data.name: BorrowWhileReleaseRecasts0
data.value: Use {0} while {1} is recasting

data.name: BorrowWhileReleaseRecastsDesc
data.value: Levels 22-29: summoning does not reset the Tempered Release recast yet. On: a fresh familiar spends One with Nature on Borrow when Tempered Release is more than 12 seconds away. Off: it waits for Tempered Release.

data.name: FinalStingAsExit
data.value: Use wespe's Final Sting as its exit

data.name: FinalStingAsExitDesc
data.value: Wespe's {0} skill (Final Sting) makes it retreat. On: it fires only as the wespe's exit, under the same rules as {1} (minimum time out, another horn ready). Off: {0} is never used on wespe.

data.name: MinFamiliarStay0
data.value: Minimum seconds a familiar fights before {0}

data.name: RefreshBetweenPulls
data.value: Refresh One with Nature between pulls

data.name: RefreshBetweenPullsDesc
data.value: From level 18, out of combat with an enemy targeted: when the current familiar has already spent One with Nature, swaps to another ready horn (no lockout out of combat) so the next pull opens with a fresh Tempered Release or Borrow. Never swaps away from the horn a held Kinship came from.

data.value: It is a GCD spell: only when the target is out of melee range (up to 30 yalms) and never in the middle of the 1-2-3 combo.

data.name: UseRallyDesc
data.value: Rally at 3 Mastered Instinct right after the axe that granted the third. Rallying Cheer with banked Natural Instinct when familiar TP is low (at 50, held for the Rally + Rallying Cheer finisher sequence).

data.name: UseScaleskinDesc
data.value: When an enemy is targeting the character. Off by default: the barrier only pays off against magic damage.

data.name: UseSeedsowerDesc
data.value: When an enemy is within 6 yalms.

data.name: UseShieldChargeDesc
data.value: As a gap closer when the target is 4-20 yalms away, and for damage in melee range when charges are full and the character is standing still. Respects the movement safety gate.

data.name: UseSoulCrushDesc
data.value: Only to interrupt an interruptible cast in melee range.

data.name: UseVileskinDesc
data.value: When an enemy is targeting the character.

data.name: CrucibleDesc
data.value: Only on a Crucible board. Sends a familiar away with Parting Blow before it is knocked out, skips the Parting Blow exit as a round ends, borrows the Kinship the enemy panel calls for before the pull (interrupt, dispel, cleanse), dispels enemy buffs, cleanses debuffs, stops attacking enemies in a counter stance, never attacks zu eggs or morphos, and saves wespe's Final Sting as an execute.

data.name: CrucibleScoreModeDesc
data.value: For high-score runs: Challenge whenever the target turns on the familiar so familiars finish at full HP; Snarl only to set up the tankbuster dodge below. Uses the Snarl / Challenge setting (Log only records, Use presses).
